Hi Rishi / Lauren,

We kicked off renewal planning for Nimbus Health today and wanted to surface a few constraints so we can align commercial structure:

- We're looking to move to a 3-year agreement (multi-year) but need a gradual ramp: first 12 months at ~45% of committed capacity, 2nd year 75%, 3rd year 100%.

Happy to hop on a quick call, but wanted to get these components into email so legal & finance have something to react to.

Maya (CC'd) and I can take a call next week.
